# Girish Lade - UI/UX Designer & Full-Stack Developer

> Portfolio, software engineering blog, and privacy-first client-side web utilities created by Girish Balaso Lade, founder of LadeStack.

Girish Lade is a UI/UX designer and full-stack developer based in Pune, India. Holding a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from SVERI's College of Engineering, Pandharpur, he transitioned into software engineering, specializing in browser-first web applications, zero-friction developer tooling, and client-side computing.

## Developer & Portfolio Overview

- [Portfolio Homepage](https://ladestack.in/en/): Core portfolio presenting engineering background, interactive 3D lanyard, verified experience, and contact channels.
- [Technical Blog](https://ladestack.in/en/blog/): Deep-dive technical articles on browser IDE architecture, client-side WebAssembly file processing, software philosophy, and developer journey.
- [GitHub Profile](https://github.com/girishlade111): Open-source repositories, developer tools, and code experiments.
- [LinkedIn Profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/girish-lade/): Professional experience, education, and career milestones.

## Featured Products & Applications

- [LadeStack](https://ladestack.in/): Fast, private, zero-onboarding utility ecosystem where compute executes entirely in the user's browser.
- [GB Coder](https://gbcoder.ladestack.in): In-browser client-side integrated development environment (IDE) powered by WebContainers, Monaco editor, and live execution runtimes.
- [LS PDF](https://lspdf.ladestack.in): In-browser, zero-upload PDF manipulation tool suite providing local PDF merging, splitting, rotation, and compression with complete user privacy.

## Technical Articles

- [Why I Built LadeStack: The Case for Browser-First, Zero-Setup Developer Tools](https://ladestack.in/en/blog/why-i-built-ladestack-browser-first-tools/): Product philosophy advocating for client-side processing over forced account walls and mystery cloud uploads.
- [Building an In-Browser IDE with Monaco Editor and WebContainers](https://ladestack.in/en/blog/building-in-browser-ide-monaco-webcontainers/): Architectural breakdown of GB Coder, Node.js runtimes in browser sandboxes, and virtual file systems.
- [Privacy-First Local File Processing in the Modern Web](https://ladestack.in/en/blog/privacy-first-local-file-processing-web/): How WebAssembly, Web Workers, and modern browser APIs enable secure, local document processing.
- [From Mechanical Engineering to Full-Stack Developer: Lessons from Self-Directed Learning](https://ladestack.in/en/blog/from-mechanical-engineering-to-fullstack-dev/): Non-traditional journey from mechanical CAD/finite element analysis to production web architecture.
